description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'InstallmentDelinquencyAggregator' for aggregating and sorting installment-level delinquency data within the Fineract project. It includes methods for grouping delinquency data by rangeId, summing delinquent amounts, and sorting by minimum age days.

classes.name: InstallmentDelinquencyAggregator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to aggregate and sort installment delinquency data by rangeId and age.

methods.name: aggregateAndSort
methods.description: Aggregates installment delinquency data by rangeId, summing delinquent amounts, and sorts the result by minimumAgeDays in ascending order.

methods.name: delinquentAmountSummingCollector
methods.description: Creates a custom collector that reduces multiple InstallmentLevelDelinquency objects with the same rangeId by summing their delinquentAmount fields while preserving range metadata.
